scripts.backup: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @vektor/api exec tsx src/maintenance/cli.ts backup
scripts.backup:verify: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @vektor/api exec tsx src/maintenance/cli.ts verify
scripts.restore: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @vektor/api exec tsx src/maintenance/cli.ts restore
scripts.desktop:dev: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @vektor/web exec tauri dev
scripts.desktop:build: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @vektor/web exec tauri build
scripts.build:packages: pnpm version:sync && pnpm --filter @vektor/shared build && pnpm --filter @vektor/db build
scripts.dev: pnpm build:packages && concurrently -k -n shared,db,api,web -c blue,green,yellow,magenta "pnpm --filter @vektor/shared dev" "pnpm --filter @vektor/db dev" "pnpm --filter @vektor/api dev" "pnpm --filter @vektor/web dev"
scripts.test: pnpm build:packages && node --test scripts/release.test.mjs && pnpm -r test
